description: Create a new assignment in a course and return the created assignment object. Each call creates another assignment — Canvas assigns a new ID every time, so check list_assignments with a search_term first to avoid duplicates. Use update_assignment to change an existing assignment instead of calling this again, and delete_assignment to remove one. due_at, lock_at, and unlock_at here apply to every student; to give a different date to a subset of students, a section, or a group, use create_assignment_override instead, or set_student_assignment_dates to fan a date change for one student across many assignments. Dates are ISO 8601 strings; lock_at must be after due_at and unlock_at before due_at when both are set. Requires instructor/TA permission to manage assignments and quizzes in the course.

assignment_group_id.description: ID of the assignment group to place this assignment in

grade_group_students_individually.description: For group assignments, whether each member is graded separately (false = one shared group grade)

lock_at.description: The date after which the assignment locks and stops accepting submissions, in ISO 8601 format. Must be after due_at when there is one

omit_from_final_grade.description: Whether to leave this assignment out of the final grade calculation

published.description: Whether the assignment is published and visible to students

unlock_at.description: The date the assignment becomes available to students, in ISO 8601 format. Must be before due_at when there is one

name: create_assignment
title: Create Assignment
